title: ChatGPT Voice gets closer to "Her" with email, calendar, and Slack access
summary: ChatGPT Voice now runs on OpenAI's new GPT-6 Astra, Sol, and Luna models and can tap into plugins like email, calendar, and Slack. Users can manage appointments, send emails, or build websites just by talking. The update moves OpenAI closer to the everyday AI assistant Sam Altman has long compared to the one in the sci-fi film "Her." The article ChatGPT Voice gets closer to "Her" with email, calendar, and Slack access appeared first on The Decoder .
